values.meaning: Root duration based on distance traveled (min to max)
values.quote: {{pp|type=distance traveled|0.75 to 2.25|0 to 1000 by 100|formula=Starts at 0.75 seconds and increases up to 2.25 seconds over 1000 units traveled}}
values.binNote: MinRootDuration=0.75 and MaxRootDuration=2.25 are separate scalar rows for the two ends of the wiki's distance-scaled range; each row carries one of the two numbers stated here, not both.

mechanics.claim: The wall of brambles accelerates over time as it advances.
mechanics.quote: slowly advances in the target direction, accelerating over time

mechanics.claim: Each of the five brambles is a separate hit that deals damage and roots independently, stopping when it hits an enemy champion.
mechanics.quote: each stopping when they collide with an enemy {{tip|champion}}

mechanics.claim: Hitting at least one enemy champion grants Maokai bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds.
mechanics.quote: Hitting at least one enemy champion grants '''Maokai''' {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 2 seconds.
